component: ZenDB v2.0.1 isolated remote-CanisterDB RBAC baseline
proves: an ungranted remote caller cannot read, write, create collections, or grant access
a collection-scoped writer can read and write only its granted collection
a collection-scoped writer cannot create collections or grant roles
a database-scoped grant intentionally spans child collections and is therefore prohibited by the target grant matrix
a non-global administrator cannot escalate a collection or database grant into a global grant
doesNotProve: post-upgrade grant preservation or the internal self-grant ingress boundary
logical-ID/hash reconciliation, mutation interruption, archive failure, low cycles, benchmarks, or collection-vN repair
